messages:
sarah.partners: FYI CloudMarket partner reported failed marketplace onboarding – provisioning API returns 502 for new listings. partner support created a ticket and marked SEV1 at 16:20 UTC. Please triage.

mike.sre: grabbing oncall. can you paste the ticket id and the partner request payload?

sarah.partners: Ticket CM-8421. Partner payload attached in their case but main failure is `POST /marketplace/v1/listings` -> 502. They say it repros consistently for new accounts.

olivia.sales: pinging account execs and legal to prep comms. need to know ETA before i reply to partner.

ryan.ps: I'll join war room. Can we create a shared channel with their SE contact + our SREs/PS/Eng?

ashley.eng: quick read: 502 looks like upstream provisioning service throwing `connection reset`. can we get logs from the provisioning lambda and the nginx edge?

oncall-sre: i'm on it. set up a war-room channel: #warroom-cloudmarket-provisioning. Invited @sarah.partners @mike.sre @ashley.eng @ryan.ps @olivia.sales and deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Automated: started trace capture for request id `req_9f3a2c` and forwarded to stacktrace repo https://internal/trace/req_9f3a2c.

mike.sre: action items: (1) war room created, (2) oncall will gather logs and put in thread, (3) eng to look at recent deploys, (4) PS to keep partner updated every 30m.

sarah.partners: partner asked for a direct escalation phone if we need it — adding their SE contact: +1-415-555-0192 (Liu Chen).

ashley.eng: I see a deploy ~15:12 that changed header handling in the marketplace proxy. rolling back to prior rev in staging now. if rollback fixes, we'll promote to prod.

oncall-sre: collected logs: `upstream prematurely closed connection` across 12 requests in the last 10m. uploading S3 bundle s3://redwood-incidents/cloudmarket/CM-8421/logs-1742500000.zip

ryan.ps: liaising with partner: told them we've opened a dedicated war room, asked for any recent changes on their side. they said no changes. keeping them updated.

olivia.sales: drafted a short notify to partner: "we're treating this as SEV1, war room active, ETA for next update 30m" — approved? :eyes:

mike.sre: approved. also created an escalation checklist pinned in the war room: 1) confirm scope (impacting new signups only or existing listings?) 2) gather request ids 3) rollback suspect deploy 4) if rollback fails, open vendor contact with infra provider 5) invoke SOW emergency clause if needed.

ashley.eng: rollback to rev `marketplace-proxy@2024-11-09-3cf2` applied to prod canary 50% at 16:46 UTC. monitoring.

deploy-bot: Canary health: failures reduced from 40% -> 5% within 4m.

oncall-sre: can confirm error rate dropped to baseline after rollback. marking incident as mitigated. prepping postmortem and next steps for partner.

sarah.partners: thanks team. next steps for partner coordination: (a) set up a permanent shared slack channel for CloudMarket (#partner-cloudmarket) with restricted guest access, (b) schedule a 1:1 post-incident review with their engineering + our platform/infra leads, (c) provide a short runbook of our SEV paths and contact numbers.

ryan.ps: will own the guest channel invite and the PR for the runbook. planning a Tuesday 09:00 UTC postmortem with CloudMarket leads.

olivia.sales: i'll own the customer comms and follow legal if any contractual impact.

mike.sre: for internal process improvements: suggest updating partner onboarding checklist to include a pre-prod smoke test against our marketplace staging env and adding partner SE contact to the reserved-contacts doc.

sarah.partners: Agree. I'll file a follow-up ticket to add smoke tests + add the escalation matrix to the partner onboarding template.

ashley.eng: will add a health-check endpoint and I'm writing a small test harness we can run during partner onboarding.

sarah.partners: closing this thread — CM-8421 mitigated, war room archived, postmortem scheduled. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
